CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

June 25, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:25 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: June 11, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the June 11, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

  Board member Ng makes request this item be moved to discussion.

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: June 11, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the June 11, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to revise item 3, for 105 South El Molino Street,
  DRB-2024-00042, to state that the original motion by Board member Hernandez
  on Jun 11, 2024 was to approve the application with the condition that any
  mechanical and/or roof vents are shown in the elevations, new or existing.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Ng

  1
   Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Daninger
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 2:  15 South Chapel Avenue, DRB-2024-00068

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 6 ft. high iron fence, gate, and vehicular
  motorized rolling gate on an existing mixed-use project site.
  •  Applicant: Ken Lee | Pacific Premier Development Group
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Daninger
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  118 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00056

  •  Request: This is an application for two (2) new wall signs on an existing 2-story
  commercial building for the business known as ‘Jumpin’ Lobster’.
  •  Applicant: Nicky Chung; Alvin Zhu, signage contractor
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Daninger
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:35 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on July 9, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:35 P.M.
  •  The second was by Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Daninger

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
